nodes.title: Fix 'Round unavailable: Unexpected token <' error in the UI
nodes.body:
Context: at http://localhost:5173/ the header shows "Round unavailable: Unexpected token '<', "<!doctype "... is not valid JSON". Cause: vite.config.ts has no server.proxy, so the Vite dev server answers /api/v1/worlds/{id}/round/current with index.html and getCurrentRound's res.json() throws SyntaxError, which describeRoundError passes through unchanged. Desired: the round loads from the Go backend in dev, and any non-JSON response is explained in plain words. Why: players must see real round state or a clear message.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the dev server is running, When the app requests /api/v1/*, Then Vite forwards it to the Go backend at http://localhost:8080
- Given the round endpoint returns HTML, When the app loads, Then the header shows a readable message and not a JSON parser message


## Scope
- In scope: game/frontend/vite.config.ts proxy
- In scope: describeRoundError in game/frontend/src/App.tsx
- Out of scope: Backend changes
- Out of scope: Header layout or Retry behaviour
- Preserve: ApiError and TypeError messages in describeRoundError
- Preserve: 404 maps to the empty state


## Technical constraints
- UI-only change; do not change the backend API
- Backend listens on :8080 (backend/configs server.addr)


## Definition of done
- Both requirements are done and verified


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: Vite dev server proxies /api to the Go backend
nodes.body:
Context: client.ts calls relative paths like /api/v1/worlds/{id}/round/current, and vite.config.ts only sets publicDir, alias and server.fs. Desired: server.proxy forwards '/api' to http://localhost:8080. Expected: the round JSON loads in dev. Why: removes the root cause of the error.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given vite.config.ts, When the config is loaded, Then server.proxy['/api'].target equals 'http://localhost:8080'
- Given the proxy is added, When the config is loaded, Then publicDir, the @game alias and server.fs.allow are unchanged


## Scope
- In scope: game/frontend/vite.config.ts
- Out of scope: Production hosting
- Out of scope: Backend CORS
- Preserve: publicDir game/public
- Preserve: @game alias
- Preserve: test config


## Technical constraints
- Port 8080 comes from backend/configs server.addr


## Definition of done
- Proxy configured and unit-tested


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: Non-JSON round responses show an explained message
nodes.body:
Context: describeRoundError in App.tsx handles ApiError, TypeError and generic Error, so a SyntaxError from res.json() falls into the generic Error branch and its message is shown. Desired: SyntaxError returns 'Round service returned an unexpected response (not JSON)'. Why: no raw parser text in the UI.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a SyntaxError, When describeRoundError runs, Then it returns 'Round service returned an unexpected response (not JSON)'
- Given an ApiError, a TypeError, another Error or a non-Error, When describeRoundError runs, Then the output is unchanged


## Scope
- In scope: describeRoundError in game/frontend/src/App.tsx
- Out of scope: client.ts changes
- Preserve: Existing describeRoundError outputs


## Technical constraints
- SyntaxError check must come before the generic Error branch


## Definition of done
- SyntaxError branch added and unit-tested


## Clarifying questions
- None
